shared_elements: carved relief detailing on the body surface
justification: Both depict a single anthropomorphic figure's head and upper body with a distinct headgear form, and both carry incised surface detail over the torso. But A is a finely detailed profile bust in low relief with naturalistic eye, ear, ringlet beard and hair, patterned garment and earring, while B is a massive, blocky, near-featureless three-dimensional figure seen from behind with only sparse schematic carved motifs (a disc, curved bands) on a smooth back — the conventions of depiction and the viewpoint of the subject share almost nothing specific.
